audit.why: Melee bruiser with passive regen who resets trades for free. Aatrox needs repeated short trades so Perseverance never ticks.
Demacian Justice (R) is 120/100/80 true-damage execute and ignores resistances entirely — health, not armour, is the answer. Existing level-6 and first-item text already say this.

Decisive Strike (Q, 8s flat) silences and breaks all slows, so it cancels your combo and escapes Infernal Chains' slow; Courage (W, 22/19.5/17/14.5/12) grants a shield and tenacity, shortening your Q3 knock-up.
